tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Cities, counties and metros on Qadir that match a name, with how many masjids and halal places each has.

tools.name: prayer_times
tools.description: The five daily prayer times and sunrise for a city on a date (today by default, in the city's time zone).

tools.name: jumuah_times
tools.description: Friday prayer (Jumu'ah) times at the masjids in a city this week, earliest first.

tools.name: iqamah_times
tools.description: Today's iqamah (congregation) times at the masjids in a city, from each masjid's own posted board, with the date the board was read. Masjids without a current board are counted, never estimated.

tools.name: masjids
tools.description: Masjids (mosques) in a city, county or metro, with addresses and Friday times where known.

tools.name: halal_food
tools.description: Halal restaurants, markets and butchers in a city, strongest halal evidence first, with today's hours and whether each is open now.

tools.name: is_chain_halal
tools.description: Whether a restaurant chain serves halal food: how many of its locations are listed and the halal evidence at each one.

tools.name: khutbahs
tools.description: Recent Friday khutbahs (sermons) from masjids in the US, Canada and Mexico, newest first, optionally on a topic or from a city.

tools.name: ramadan_2027
tools.description: Suhoor end (Fajr) and iftar (Maghrib) times for every day of Ramadan 2027 (expected February 8 to March 8, 2027) in a city.
